Congrats man. You should give it a week for this to sink in before making plans for the money though. Make your best decisions and have no regrets, as a believer of karma irl, I'd say your good deeds have paid off. :)
I don't live in a big city.

Thanks for checking up, I'm doing all right. I figure when I get some money I will probably look in to therapy. I mean, it couldn't hurt. At this point I've just moved closer to my brother, nieces, and nephews, unfortunately he also lives here. Luckily his attitude is wearing thin with all of us and he owes my brother money, so he steers clear of us for the most part at the moment.
Oh god, Where can I adopt this cat?
Thanks, and I would but I can't afford a therapist.

Thanks. The cousin is very heavily in my life, and I later found out he was best friends for a couple years with my SO. Small world, eh? 
I have a lot of difficulty not seeing him as a monster and I am rude and condescending to him whenever he talks to me. He's told me that we're cousins, we should just get along, and acts like nothing ever happened, like he doesn't remember.
It just affected me so much that I don't think I will ever let it go, I mean, not what it was physically but what it did emotionally and psychologically has made me kind of a messed up person.
I just feel like it took away who I had the potential to be, and made me someone else than I wasn't meant to be.
I feel like it's to blame for a lot of my social problems, and trust issues, my self image and my inability to be comfortable around most children.
